attempts.text:
Only Tarkeshwar shelter is a designated evacuation point, so Myagang temple can't be a drop-off. I read "two men and women" at Tadi farm as 2 adults, since the report is ambiguous.

- **First trip:** Myagang is 20 minutes each way, so the round trip is 40 minutes. The car takes the 3 elderly people and 1 adult. Deferring them instead would cost 170, so the trip is worth it.
- **Second Myagang trip:** This would cost another 40 minutes to save the remaining 2 adults, which is exactly their deferral penalty (2 × 20 = 40). It is a tie, so I defer them.
- **Tadi farm:** The detour is 44 extra minutes (22 each way) to save 2 adults worth 40, so I defer them.

Total: 40 minutes of driving plus 4 deferred adults at 20 each (80 in penalties) is 120.

<plan>
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter myagang-temple
load car1 elderly 3
load car1 adult 1
drive car1 myagang-temple tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
unload car1 adult 1
defer myagang-temple adult 2
defer tadi-farm adult 2
</plan>
COST: 120
